name: git-standup

patches.new:
mkdir -p git-standup
offline_fetch "https://github.com/nilbuild/git-standup/archive/a8031b89636791936fa00c3e64799748572a9e11.tar.gz" git-standup-source.tar.gz || exit $?
tar -xzf git-standup-source.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C git-standup

resources.checksum_source: locally-pinned official GitHub commit source archive

smoke: mkdir -p /tmp/standup-project; cd /tmp/standup-project; git init -q; git config user.name Offline; git config user.email offline@example.invalid; printf demo > demo; git add demo; git commit --allow-empty -qm offline-commit; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/git-standup" -a Offline -d 1 > /tmp/standup-result; grep -q offline-commit /tmp/standup-result
notes: Converts the official git clone + make install shell installer. Bundles the exact Git commit archive, preserving make install, and quotes BINDIR in the upstream Makefile invocation to support spaces.
Git and make are explicit prerequisites. Functional check creates a local Git commit and asserts the standup report includes it.
